title: Chapter 246 - 246 Open The Golden Packets!
content:
Chapter 246 - 246 Open The Golden Packets!

Chapter 246 - 246 Open the Golden Packets!

246 Open the Golden Packets!

Lin Fan had no idea what Deng Jihu was thinking.

At this moment, he was heading toward the Coiling Dragon Villa at his fastest speed.

When the security guards at the entrance saw Lin Fan, they stood straight like soldiers and greeted him respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

Lin Fan nodded his head casually and walked into the villa.

Then, he focused all his attention on the system.

Lin Fan looked at the dazzling golden packets in the system and said excitedly, “Let me see what I can get from these five golden packets!

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon. You can double your shares. More shares, more assets, and more charming charm.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten Rolls-Royce Phantoms.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained one bag of Spirit Tea Seeds.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five million yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five million yuan.]

Lin Fan ignored the two 5,000,000 yuan.

Ten Rolls-Royce Phantoms.

One had to know

Each Rolls-Royce Phantom cost more than ten million yuan, so ten of them would cost 100 million yuan!

Double shares coupon.

Lin Fan now owned 51% of the shares of the Yinshan Group, Qingkun Group, Xiao Wu Wholesale City, and other companies. The market value of these companies was more than ten billion.

Once he used the double shares coupon on one of the companies, Lin Fan would have 100% control over the company.

His assets would increase by tens, hundreds, or even tens of billions!

However, Lin Fan did not plan to use it on these companies because he still owned 5% of LV, Gucci, Volkswagen Group, Little Tanuki, Penguin, and other super companies.

The market value of these companies was close to a trillion or more.

Especially Little Tanuki and Penguin, which were super giants with a market value of five trillion!

If he used the double shares coupon on one of these companies, then Lin Fan would have 10% of the company’s shares and his assets would instantly increase by hundreds of billions!

This was definitely a terrifying number.

Lin Fan first ruled out LV, Gucci, and the Volkswagen Group.

Firstly, it was because their market value was relatively low, and it was not worth it to use the double shares coupon.

Secondly, these three companies were related to clothes, bags, and cars Lin Fan did not lack these things at all, and he was not too interested in them either.

Thirdly, Lin Fan knew that Little Tanuki and Penguin belonged to a giant company in the country.

However, a large portion of their shares were in the hands of foreigners

Lin Fan had a vision. If he could get a few more double shares coupons…

Soon, these two giant companies would belong to him and return to the country.

Thinking of this

After pondering for a moment, Lin Fan had finally made a decision.

[Ding! Do you want to use the double shares coupon on Penguin Corporation?]

“Yes!]

[Ding! Usage successful. You now own a total of 10% of Penguin Corporation’s shares.]

Lin Fan’s net worth had increased by another 250 billion!

Seeing this

Lin Fan’s lips curled up.

Then, he turned his attention to the Spiritual Tea Seeds.

[Spirit Tea Seed: It can quickly grow fresh and natural tea leaves. The tea has the effects of expelling toxins from the body, rejuvenating the body, and prolonging life.]

Seeing this

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up immediately.

Expel the toxins in the body, rejuvenate the spirit, and prolong life The name Spirit Tea was absolutely appropriate!

When Lin Fan raised his head, a bag of seeds had already appeared in front of him.

Obviously This was the bag of Spirit Tea Seeds.

Outside the window in the distance, a row of Rolls-Royce Phantoms appeared.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

…

Tonight, Lin Fan slept very comfortably.

The next day, after the sun rose, a rumbling sound came from outside.

A large group of construction workers arrived at the entrance of the Coiling Dragon villa complex.

Lin Fan heard the voice and opened his eyes slowly.

He first casually glanced at his phone. As usual, a text message appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 3,650,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

When he opened the door, two security guards happened to walk over.

“Mr. Lin, there’s a group of construction workers outside. They said that you asked them to come over?” the security guard said.

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Yes, let them in.”

“Alright.” The security guards did not dare to ask any more questions. They turned around and let more than a dozen construction workers in.

Among them

The person walking in front was the manager of Lin Fan’s Flying Dragon Security Company, Wang Shengli.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.” Wang Shengli said respectfully, “These people are all skilled construction workers. They can build walls, stick ceramic tiles, and make furniture. There’s nothing they don’t know how to do”

“Can they demolish houses?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes!” Wang Shengli said without hesitation.

“Alright then. You guys can tear down the villa at the back.” Lin Fan pointed into the distance.

Wang Shengli, the construction workers, and the security guards standing not far away were all stunned.

Demolish the villa?

Tearing down a palace-like villa?

Seeing that Wang Shengli and the workers did not reply, Lin Fan frowned and asked, “What’s wrong? You don’t know how to demolish it?”

Wang Shengli was the first to react and said, “Of course not. Brothers, let’s go!”

“Remember to take away all the bricks, cement, marble, furniture, and other things. Leave only an empty space,” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, don’t worry. I’ll definitely do a clean job!” Wang Shengli patted his chest.

The security guards felt their throats go dry as they watched the large group of workers leave.

Finally, a security guard could not help but ask, “M-Mr. Lin, you’re demolishing that villa because…”

“Oh, I want to start a tea plantation there. It should be quite good to plant tea by the lake.” Lin Fan smiled.

When the security guards heard this, they were instantly stunned.

One had to know

This was the Coiling Dragon Villa by Tianhu Lake. Each villa was worth at least 200 to 300 million!

Demolishing a villa worth at least 200 to 300 million yuan to… plant tea?

This…

This…

Was this the world of the rich?

Naturally, Lin Fan did not pay attention to the stunned security guard. He got into one of the Rolls-Royce Phantoms that he had just obtained last night. He stepped on the accelerator and sped into the distance.

The Rolls-Royce Phantom was very wide and large, looking very heavy.

However, it had a 6.7L V12 engine that could produce 571 horsepower, so its acceleration and reaction speed were not slow at all.

Lin Fan went to a two-star Michelin Western restaurant a few kilometers away and ordered truffle egg tarts, shrimp pancakes, black pudding, and skimmed milk.

He spent a total of 2,780 yuan and ate a simple breakfast before continuing to drive the Rolls-Royce Phantom to Jiangbei University, which he had not been to for a few days.
